senses.gloss: m. (preced.) smearing with a fatty substance, glazing.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 17a:21">M. Kat. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>ומהניא ביה כי ט׳ בתנורא</he> and (the excommunication) retains its effect on him as does the glazing on the tiles of the oven.

<cite ref="Pesachim 30a:8">Pes. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>ההוא תנורא דטחו ביה ט׳</he> an oven which they smeared with fat for glazing purposes; <cite ref="Zevachim 95b:9">Zeb. 95ᵇ</cite> <he>דאטחו בה טיחייה</he> (Ms. R. 2 <he>טחו … טחויי</he>; Ms. K. <cite ref="I00265"><he>טְחָיֵי</he></cite> ‘in which they baked cakes smeared with fat’, Rashi; v. <cite ref="I00265"><he>טְחָיֵי</he></cite>).
